claims.claim: M1 baseline and M2 2-D backbone were run under common boundary/physics conventions; dimensional effect and discretization error are separately recorded.
M3 state-law route was run for 3 h; M2 constant-law and M4 temperature-field cases are comparators, not observational-fit improvements.
The first full-domain moisture-threshold crossing was bracketed on a 60 s grid and checked by time refinement.
Moving-radius reference and moving-FV paths, geometry/dry-solid conservation, interpolation sensitivity and Jacobian ablation were executed.
Boundary, empirical-law, terminal-window and radius-interpolation pressure tests are reported without claiming causal or observational validation.

key_values.route: H2-approved 2-D consistency route; M1 baseline, M2 backbone, M3 main, M4 ablation
key_values.pressure_test: 4 h terminal-window and hm/prefactor sensitivity; see sensitivity.csv
key_values.interpretation_limit: conditional simulation under problem-supplied empirical laws; no observational fit claim
